'''Ilaani Soresh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the wife of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]]. When her son [[Kimali Soresh]] joined a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers, Ilaani tried to help her son escape capture. She confided the whole matter to her husband so that he may bid his son farewell. But Rezi turned Ilaani and Kimali in to the Empire, resulting in a life sentence for both of them on the [[Gree Baaker Labor Camp]].
